1. Load the spotify dataset (available in github repository).
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
SpotifyData <- spotifyDat_Fall26
SpotifyData
```


```{r}

```

2. Create a bar graph of the artist column`
(Hint: use theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) to rotate the x axis).
```



```{r}
ggplot(SpotifyData, aes(x= artist))+geom_bar()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

```

3. Add genre as a third variable in your graph.
```{r}
ggplot(SpotifyData, aes(x= artist, fill=genre))+geom_bar()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

4. Use color brewer to add color to your graph in 3. 
```{r}
ggplot(SpotifyData, aes(x= artist, fill=genre))+geom_bar()+scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

5. Place the legend for the graph you made in 3 on the bottom of the graph. 
```{r}
ggplot(SpotifyData, aes(x= artist, fill=genre))+geom_bar()+scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),legend.position= "bottom")
```

As you probably recognized, the graph you made is really hard to read.

6. Separate the genre column into multiple columns (e.g. so each genre listed is in a unique column)
```{r}
SpotifySPOT<- separate(SpotifyData, genre, into=c("genre1", "genre2", "genre3", "genre4"), sep =",")
```

7. Use these genre columns to create a dataset in long format. 
```{r}
SpotLong<-pivot_longer(SpotifySPOT,cols = c("genre1", "genre2", "genre3", "genre4"), names_to="genre_num",values_to="genre",values_drop_na=TRUE)
```

8.use facet wrap to make graphs of artist by genre 
```{r}
ggplot(SpotLong,aes(x = artist))+geom_bar()+facet_wrap(~genre)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

```

9. Create a graph that includes the variables tempo and dancability. 
```{r}
ggplot(SpotLong, aes(x=tempo, y=danceability))+geom_point()
```

10. Add popularity as a third variable. 
```{r}
ggplot(SpotLong, aes(x=tempo, y=danceability, color=popularity))+geom_point()
```

11. Use viridis as a color in your graph from #10
```{r}
library(viridis)
```

```{r}
ggplot(SpotLong, aes(x=tempo, y=danceability, color=popularity))+geom_point()+scale_color_viridis()

```
